vulnerability_patterns.description: Before the patch, a length derived from the note name field was used directly as the byte count for numeric decoding, causing the loop to keep reading bytes from `name` and shifting/accumulating them into a fixed-width integer without first proving that the encoded numeric value fits. After the patch, oversized numeric encodings are rejected before the loop.
trigger_conditions: `bytes` is computed from `pnote->namesz - (name - pnote->namedata)` or an equivalent remaining-length expression
`bytes` controls a loop such as `while (bytes --)` that consumes `* name ++`
the loop decodes bytes into a fixed-width integer using a shift/accumulation pattern
there is no prior guard equivalent to `bytes <= sizeof (val)` before the decode loop
fix_patterns: widen the numeric accumulator from `unsigned long` to `unsigned long long`
on guard failure, report the corrupt `namesz` and `return FALSE` before consuming `name`
keep the numeric decode loop reachable only when the byte count fits the accumulator width
affected_functions: binutils/readelf.c numeric GNU build attribute decoding block
evidence_lines: error (_("corrupt name field: namesz of %lu is too large for a numeric value\n"),

entry_points: binutils/readelf.c numeric GNU build attribute decoding block
suggestions: 首稿优先命中 patch-local 锚点：`bytes = pnote->namesz - (name - pnote->namedata)` 后进入 `while (bytes --)` 并读取 `* name ++`。
核心 sink 是 unchecked length 驱动的 numeric decode loop，而不是新增的 `error` 或 `printf`。
首稿不要把 `if (bytes > sizeof (val)) return FALSE` 写成必须存在的硬过滤；应先找缺少该 barrier 的旧形态。
`bytes <= sizeof(val)`、`return FALSE`、错误日志内容适合作为二次收敛条件，用于确认这是 oversized numeric field 防护。
需要局部数据流追踪 `bytes` 从 `pnote->namesz` 到 loop bound，以及 `val` 的固定宽度；通常不需要跨文件分析。
同时可辅助检查循环体内是否存在按 `shift` 组装整数的模式，但不要要求完整跨过程语义。

affected_functions: binutils/readelf.c numeric GNU build attribute decoding block
key_functions: binutils/readelf.c numeric GNU build attribute decoding block
analysis_rationale: The patch-local fix adds a guard on `bytes`, derived from `pnote->namesz - (name - pnote->namedata)`, before the numeric decode loop `while (bytes --)`. The old code consumed an unchecked name-field length as the loop bound for reading `* name ++` and accumulating into `val`; the new code rejects cases where `bytes > sizeof (val)` with `error (...)` and `return FALSE`. The type of `val` is also widened from `unsigned long` to `unsigned long long`, tying the bound directly to the destination integer width.
